CONCEPTUAL_GEOMETRY_ASSUMPTION.expected_result: A physical or hybrid component receives grounded CAD evidence and the assumption is superseded.
CONCEPTUAL_GEOMETRY_ASSUMPTION.acceptance: TestQL and EQL pass; the exact finding disappears from the next ProjectIntegrityDSL.
CONCEPTUAL_GEOMETRY_ASSUMPTION.rollback: Restore the last-known-good scene and physical-evidence revision.

GEOMETRY_VALIDATION_INCOMPLETE.expected_result: Required pose and constraint evidence is collected according to SpatialClassDSL.
GEOMETRY_VALIDATION_INCOMPLETE.acceptance: Required geometry checks pass and evidence completeness advances.
GEOMETRY_VALIDATION_INCOMPLETE.rollback: Discard candidate evidence and retain the previous verified evidence set.
